rows.note: This is the all-purpose Cantonese noun for a commercial or advertisement, including one on television or radio.

example.jyutping: ni1 dyun6 gwong2 gou3 hou2 jau5 cong3 ji3

rows.note: This is the all-purpose adjective for things related to commerce or business, especially before a noun such as 商業活動.

example.english: Our company has been holding many more commercial activities lately.
example.traditional: 我哋公司近排多咗好多商業活動。
example.jyutping: ngo5 dei6 gung1 si1 gan6 paai4 do1 zo2 hou2 do1 soeng1 jip6 wut6 dung6
